answer.answerText: A change to the PAPER settlement strategy would primarily affect Trading Core's PaperSettlementService and its PaperSettlementExitTest. The service controls PAPER-mode account lookup and validation, fill selection, balance updates, position changes, equity and P&L settlement, and EXIT handling. The tests encode expected long-exit and short-exit cash, asset, equity, P&L, and trade-status outcomes, so they would need updating or expansion when those rules change. TradingCalculatorService may also be affected if the revised strategy changes P&L calculation.

claims.text: PaperSettlementService is the production component that performs PAPER settlement and handles account validation, fill selection, balances, positions, equity, and exit settlement.
PaperSettlementExitTest directly verifies PAPER exit settlement for long and short trades, including balances, equity, P&L, and closed trade status.
TradingCalculatorService is a likely affected dependency if the settlement strategy changes how exit P&L is calculated.

The production settlement logic and exit tests were introduced or changed together for local full-exit behavior, indicating that strategy changes should update both implementation and behavioral tests.

evidence.excerpt: settle checks for ExecutionMode.PAPER, selects a fill, updates balances and positions for non-exits, and delegates exits to settleExit; exit settlement updates balances, calculates P&L, closes the trade, and updates equity.
Tests assert long-exit and short-exit USD/BTC balances, equity, P&L, and CLOSED trade status.
The commit added separate EXIT settlement behavior and introduced TradingCalculatorService into PaperSettlementService.
